fields.label: Factor Name
fields.description: e.g. 'coordination_structure'. Every row sharing the same factor_name is one LEVEL of that factor; the experiment's cell count is the product of each distinct factor_name's level count.

fields.label: Level Label
fields.description: Human-readable label for this level, e.g. 'Specialist Handoff'.

fields.label: Factor Type
fields.description: What this level actually varies at launch. Limited today to the two independent knobs run_architecture() exposes -- varying model/memory profile per factor would require per-combination EORL Architecture documents (actor_slots bind specific agent templates), so model/memory variation is expressed by making 'architecture' itself the factor.

fields.label: Regime Shift
fields.description: Set when factor_type = regime_shift. Leave blank for a 'no shift' baseline level.

fields.label: Is Baseline Level
fields.description: Marks this level as the reference level for this factor (V2 section 19's ablation framing: other levels are described relative to this one).
